_comment: ETH Cali swag catalogue — the seed input for scripts/seed-swag.ts.
Copy to swag-catalogue.json and fill in real values. That file is gitignored
because metadata CIDs and pricing change per drop.
PRICES ARE HUMAN-READABLE. The seeder parses each one with the token's own
decimals, so write "25" for 25 USDC (6 decimals) and "0.01" for 0.01 ETH.
Never write base units here — that is exactly how a 10^12 pricing error
SUPPLY IS SPLIT ACROSS TWO SALES CHANNELS:
onchainCap  units sellable here via buy(), paid in crypto
voucherCap  units reserved for Shopify, claimed with a signed voucher
Set the Shopify product's inventory to exactly voucherCap. The two counters
are separate on purpose — one shared cap would let a Shopify checkout and an
on-chain buy() both see the last unit and oversell a physical item.
Token keys are resolved per chain from config: USDC, COPm (Celo only),
and ETH for the chain's native token. A token missing on the target chain
is skipped with a warning rather than failing the whole seed.
Each variant becomes a tokenId, 1-indexed in array order.
SKU must be unique — the seeder uses it to skip products already deployed,

products.name: ETH Cali Hoodie
products.description: Heavyweight hoodie, embroidered ETH Cali mark
